title: ACOR: incremental evidence accumulation towards real-time DNA storage reconstruction
abstract: arXiv:2610.36500v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: DNA offers high-density, durable storage by encoding digital information into synthetic strands and retrieving it through sequencing. Sequence reconstruction combines noisy copies of each strand before downstream decoding. Conventional offline methods typically reconstruct completed read clusters, separating reconstruction from ongoing read collection. Streaming reconstruction offers a way to overlap evidence processing with sequencing and reduce the computation remaining before downstream decoding. We present ACOR, a streaming consensus reconstruction method that records $k$-mer transitions and boundary support in a persistent ledger, then decodes through length-constrained beam search and priority-based selection at cluster closure. Evaluation on real and simulated DNA-storage datasets showed competitive recovery. translated_title: ACOR：面向实时DNA存储重建的增量证据积累方法
translated_abstract: DNA通过将数字信息编码到合成链中并通过测序进行检索，可提供高密度、持久的存储方式。序列重建是在下游解码之前，将每条链的多个含噪声副本组合起来的过程。传统的离线方法通常只重建已完成的读段集群，将重建过程与正在进行的读段收集分离开来。流式重建则提供了一种将证据处理与测序过程并行重叠的途径，从而减少下游解码前剩余的计算量。我们提出了ACOR，一种流式共识重建方法，它在持久账本中记录k-mer转换和边界支持信息，然后通过长度约束的束搜索以及集群闭合时基于优先级的选择来完成解码。在真实和模拟DNA存储数据集上的评估显示，ACOR具有有竞争力的恢复效果。在我们自己的短读长下一代测序（NGS）湿实验文库上，ACOR在实现接近完全恢复的同时，以第二次……
tldr: ACOR是一种面向DNA存储的流式共识重建方法，通过在持久账本中增量记录k-mer转换与边界支持证据，并利用长度约束束搜索进行解码，实现了与测序并行的实时序列重建，恢复效果接近完全且具有竞争力。
en_tdlr: ACOR is a streaming consensus reconstruction method for DNA storage that incrementally accumulates k-mer transition and boundary support evidence in a persistent ledger and decodes via length-constrained beam search, achieving real-time reconstruction with near-complete, competitive recovery.
